limitations: This records targeted compositor/runtime integration checks, not a full game walkthrough.
No save/restore, audio, mobile original-game, physical GPU, or final hostManagedFullscreen runtime verification is claimed by this report.
Context-loss check affects the optional compositor only, not the original SDL game context.
1280x800 screenshots show scaled original artwork; 2160p is output resolution, not replacement HD assets.
App/runtime development was concurrent. Hashes below were captured after the checks; final delivery must compare them and repeat affected checks after runtime changes.

reproducedFindings.observed: Uncaught ExitStatus; launch hidden, no notice, original canvas 0x0. onAbort/onExit do not surface this failure.
reproducedFindings.suggestedRemedy: Preflight required original-runtime WebGL on a separate canvas or surface runtime startup/ExitStatus failure explicitly.
reproducedFindings.resolution: Fixed by root and passed targeted retest; see targetedFailureRetest.

reproducedFindings.trigger: Fresh browser context; indexedDB.open throws SecurityError; click Play
reproducedFindings.observed: Backend console.error and native alert Error initializing files, then pageerror. Launch remains hidden and shell storage notice is absent.
reproducedFindings.suggestedRemedy: Preflight IndexedDB and show an explicit startup error, or have the backend communicate initialization failure through a shell callback. Do not claim gameplay continues without persistence unless implemented.
reproducedFindings.resolution: Fixed by root and passed targeted retest; see targetedFailureRetest.

reproducedFindings.trigger: After original game boots, lose the original #canvas WebGL context using WEBGL_lose_context
reproducedFindings.observed: No user-facing notice or status change. Existing context-loss handling covers the optional overlay only.
reproducedFindings.suggestedRemedy: Handle original-context loss separately and offer a clear reload instruction; do not claim original engine recovery without verifying it.
reproducedFindings.resolution: Fixed by root and passed targeted retest; see targetedFailureRetest.

targetedFailureRetest.scope: Only the three reproduced failure cases were rerun after root fixes; no additional full-game or compositor-journey claim.
